content.voice_instructions: Male presenter in his late 30s delivering a professional news broadcast. Deep, authoritative, and perfectly articulated English with a neutral General American broadcast accent. Maintains a calm, steady, and measured pace suitable for global technology news reporting, projecting clarity, poise, and journalistic objectivity throughout.

vo_lines: Welcome to Tech Update. Today, DeepSeek releases open-weights model R1, quantum hardware crosses a key error threshold, and the EU AI Act enters into force. DeepSeek R1 offers frontier reasoning at a fraction of standard training costs.
The release triggered a massive global selloff in AI stocks, wiping nearly 590 billion dollars from Nvidia in a single session. Meanwhile, Google unveiled its Willow quantum chip.

Willow proved that adding physical qubits reduces error rates, crossing a crucial milestone in quantum error correction. In global policy, the European Union's comprehensive AI Act has officially entered into force.
The law phases in obligations by risk tier, targeting unacceptable risks and general-purpose AI models throughout 2025. That covers today's bulletin. Thank you for watching.
